facts.fact: Zambia is rolling out the Integrated National Registration Information System, a new biometric digital ID system that aims to issue digital IDs to all citizens aged 16 and over at an estimated cost of $54.8 million, with biometric records collected for 1.3 million people by May 2024, per CSIS.

The Smart Zambia Institute is piloting MOSIP's EET (e-Signet) to connect existing biometric ID databases with digital services for eKYC and authentication, with drought relief management named as its first use.
